gloss: (of houses or shops) to stand side by side

definitions.gloss: (of houses or shops) to stand side by side; to line a street
definitions.explanation: Literally, to set eaves in a row: houses or shops are built close together along a street. Used for the look of a street, often with old shops, stalls or restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒|のき}を{並|なら}べる。
examples.english: Old shops stand side by side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒|のき}を{並|なら}べて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Izakaya line the street in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒|のき}を{並|なら}べて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Shops that have been in business since the Edo period line this street.

notes:
The subject is the buildings, with が; 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧ is part of the fixed phrase. Usually in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒|のき}を{並|なら}べる: shops line the street
- ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軒|のき}を{並|なら}べる: food stalls stand in a row
- ⟦{軒|のき}→軒：03912_noki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つら}ねる→連ねる：02080_tsuraneru⟧: the same meaning, slightly more literary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立|た}ち{並|なら}ぶ: to stand in a row; for buildings, trees, people
- ⟦{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる→肩を並べる：18128_katawonaraberu⟧: to be on a par with (people, not buildings)
